{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Compute the number of penguins included
n_penguins = len(filtered_df)

# Print the required values
print(f"mean_body_mass: {mean_body_mass}")
print(f"n_penguins: {n_penguins}")"}
